body: The stiff mop with a rinse bucket carry brown foam from the greenhouse test. They were packed before the telephone line died.
title: Stiff mop with a rinse bucket at before Thursday lunch

body: The men at the road took our spare fuel and said the next checkpoint would let us through. I wrote the amount on the back of the grocery slip. There was no checkpoint there, only the cars they had already turned around.
title: Receipt for passage
